_doc: Subjects for tools/refdraw.mjs (Codex redraws) and tools/fal-job.mjs (image-to-3D). Armour and weapons follow the Chibi 2.6 round-5 (g5_*) sets in avatar-3d/data/gear-catalog.json; `chibi` = that catalog id.
style: stylized low-poly hand-painted fantasy online-RPG game art: chunky simple readable shapes, slightly exaggerated proportions, large hands and feet, hand-painted colour with soft painted-in highlights and shadows, crisp colour blocks, almost no fine surface noise, matte, NOT photoreal, NOT glossy, NOT a 3D render with realistic materials.

items.look: adult human man, heroic stylized proportions about 6.5 heads tall, broad shoulders and simple painted muscles (not bodybuilder detail), warm tan skin, messy dark-brown hair kept fairly close to the head so helmets fit over it, wearing ONLY plain dark-grey briefs, barefoot

adult human woman, heroic athletic stylized proportions about 6.5 heads tall, warm tan skin, dark-brown hair tied back in a short high ponytail close to the head so helmets fit over it, teal eyes, wearing ONLY a plain dark-grey sports top and plain dark-grey briefs, barefoot

small goblin about 3 heads tall, olive-green skin, very large pointed ears sticking out sideways, big round yellow eyes with black pupils, round head, two small lower fangs, small orange nose, stubby arms and legs, wearing ONLY a plain short brown cloth loincloth so armour can be put over it, barefoot

items.name: Gang hook

items.name: Officer sabre

items.look: officer's curved sabre with a polished steel blade, a gold basket hand-guard, deep blue grip with gold wire

items.name: Lamplord staff
items.view: Flat front view of the whole staff standing upright, orthographic, filling the height of the picture.
items.look: regal tall white-and-gold staff topped with an ornate gold lantern cage holding a glowing warm white flame, gold rings along the shaft

items.name: Silver rapier
items.view: Flat front view of the whole sword standing upright, point up, orthographic.
items.look: elegant rapier: long thin silver blade, ornate silver swept hilt with blue gems, small round pommel

items.name: Orc axe
items.view: Flat side view of the whole weapon standing upright, head up, orthographic.
items.look: brutal orc war axe: a huge crude jagged iron blade on one side, a thick wooden haft wrapped in hide strips, bone spike on top

items.name: Bone club
items.view: Flat side view of the whole weapon standing upright, head up, orthographic.
items.look: troll club made from a huge animal thigh bone, knobbly end at the top bound with leather and teeth

items.name: Minotaur greataxe
items.view: Flat front view of the whole weapon standing upright, head up, orthographic, filling the height of the picture.
items.look: huge double-bladed bronze greataxe with curved crescent blades and engraved spirals, long dark wooden haft with bronze rings

items.name: Bristleback boar
items.look: big wild boar, hostile enemy with a mean, menacing expression (NOT cute, NOT friendly): dark brown coarse bristly hide, a tall ridge of stiff black bristles along the spine, long curved yellowed tusks, small angry red eyes, mud-caked legs and hooves, short tufted tail

items.name: Thornback bear
items.look: huge brown bear, hostile enemy with a mean, menacing expression (NOT cute, NOT friendly): shaggy dark brown fur, patches of green moss and a row of curved bramble thorns growing out of its back and shoulders, old scars on the snout, mouth closed with fangs showing at the lips, big claws

items.name: Mire toad
items.look: giant swamp toad the size of a pony, hostile enemy with a mean, menacing expression (NOT cute, NOT friendly): warty mottled olive-green and ochre skin with a pale belly, big golden eyes with slit pupils on top of a wide flat head, wide closed mouth, thick front legs and big folded back legs standing up off the ground, webbed feet

items.name: Field scarecrow
items.look: living animated scarecrow, hostile enemy with a mean, menacing expression (NOT cute, NOT friendly): a burlap sack head with an angry stitched mouth and two ragged eye holes with faint orange light inside, a battered wide straw hat, a patched brown farmer coat over a stuffed body, rope belt, straw bursting out at the wrists, neck and ankles, thin legs in torn trousers, straw-stuffed burlap hands; LARGE readable hands with exactly FIVE fingers each (four fingers and a thumb)

items.name: Bandit chief
items.look: burly human bandit chieftain, hostile enemy with a mean, menacing expression (NOT cute, NOT friendly): broad-shouldered middle-aged man, black braided beard, shaved head with a red cloth band, scar across one eye, heavy brown studded leather coat with a thick wolf-fur collar, one battered iron pauldron on the right shoulder, many belts with pouches and a gold chain, dark trousers, heavy boots; LARGE readable hands with exactly FIVE fingers each (four fingers and a thumb)

items.name: Goblin warchief
items.look: big burly goblin war leader, hostile enemy with a mean, menacing expression (NOT cute, NOT friendly): green skin, long pointed ears with iron rings, jutting underbite fangs, red war paint stripes, a horned iron helmet with a bone crest, mismatched scrap iron chest plate over a fur vest, a cape of stitched rat pelts, spiked leather bracers, bare clawed feet; LARGE readable hands with exactly FIVE fingers each (four fingers and a thumb)

items.name: Hooded cultist
items.look: human cultist, hostile enemy with a mean, menacing expression (NOT cute, NOT friendly): deep crimson hooded robe with black trim, face half-hidden under the hood with a pale bone half-mask over the eyes, a black sash hung with bone charms and a small iron bell, rope belt, bare dirty feet; LARGE readable hands with exactly FIVE fingers each (four fingers and a thumb)

items.name: Marsh hag
items.look: old swamp witch, hostile enemy with a mean, menacing expression (NOT cute, NOT friendly): grey-green warty skin, long hooked nose, long stringy black hair tangled with weeds, a ragged shawl of moss and old fishing net over a tattered dark green dress, necklaces of bones and small bottles, long clawed fingers, bare feet; standing straight, not hunched; LARGE readable hands with exactly FIVE fingers each (four fingers and a thumb)

items.name: Bog lurker
items.look: hulking swamp creature, hostile enemy with a mean, menacing expression (NOT cute, NOT friendly): a heavy body of dark peat and mud with tangled roots and moss growing over it, tufts of reeds on the shoulders, a wide frog-like mouth, small sunken yellow eyes, very long thick arms, stumpy legs; LARGE readable hands with exactly FIVE fingers each (four fingers and a thumb)

items.name: Barrow king
items.look: undead skeletal king, hostile enemy with a mean, menacing expression (NOT cute, NOT friendly): a grey-brown skull with cold pale-blue light in the eye sockets, a corroded bronze crown fused to the skull, ancient green-patina bronze armour: breastplate, round pauldrons and a skirt of bronze plates, a tattered dark purple royal cloak, gold burial torc around the neck, bony arms and legs between the armour; LARGE readable hands with exactly FIVE fingers each (four fingers and a thumb)

items.name: Barrow ghoul
items.look: gaunt corpse-eating ghoul, hostile enemy with a mean, menacing expression (NOT cute, NOT friendly): grey-green leathery skin stretched over ribs, long lank black hair, sunken glowing yellow eyes, a wide mouth of jagged teeth, ragged grey burial wrappings around the hips and one arm, long thin arms with long dark claws, bare feet; LARGE readable hands with exactly FIVE fingers each (four fingers and a thumb)

items.name: Fen harpy
items.look: harpy, hostile enemy with a mean, menacing expression (NOT cute, NOT friendly): a wild woman's face and upper body with grey-blue skin, a mane of dark feathers instead of hair, big feathered wings growing along the arms ending in clawed hands, brown and slate feathers over the body, bird legs below the knee with big black talons, a short tail of feathers; LARGE readable hands with exactly FIVE fingers each (four fingers and a thumb)

items.name: Hill ogre
items.look: huge fat hill ogre, hostile enemy with a mean, menacing expression (NOT cute, NOT friendly): tan-grey warty skin, a big belly, tiny eyes under a heavy brow, one snaggle tooth, a few greasy hairs, a crude leather loincloth with a bone belt, a single fur strap over one shoulder, thick legs, wrapped feet; LARGE readable hands with exactly FIVE fingers each (four fingers and a thumb)

items.name: Rusty pitchfork
items.view: Flat front view of the whole tool standing upright, tines up, orthographic, filling the height of the picture.
items.look: farm pitchfork with three long rusty iron tines on a long grey weathered wooden shaft wrapped with old rope near the bottom

items.name: Chieftain's axe
items.view: Flat side view of the whole weapon standing upright, head up, orthographic.
items.look: big bearded war axe with a wide crescent iron blade notched from use, a spike on the back, dark wooden haft with red leather grip and a fur tuft tied under the head

items.name: Warchief's cleaver
items.view: Flat side view of the whole weapon standing upright, blade up, orthographic.
items.look: huge jagged goblin cleaver sword: a wide crude slab of rusty iron with saw teeth on the back edge, a bone handle wrapped in leather, a small skull on the pommel

items.name: Ritual knife
items.view: Flat side view of the whole knife standing upright, blade up, orthographic, filling the height of the picture.
items.look: curved ritual dagger with a wavy dark steel blade, a crimson-wrapped handle and a small bone crossguard

items.name: Hag's driftwood staff
items.view: Flat front view of the whole staff standing upright, orthographic, filling the height of the picture.

items.name: Barrow blade
items.view: Flat front view of the whole sword standing upright, blade up, orthographic, filling the height of the picture.
items.look: ancient two-handed bronze greatsword with a broad leaf-shaped blade covered in green patina, a gold-wrapped long grip and a round pommel set with a pale blue stone

items.name: Ogre club
items.view: Flat side view of the whole club standing upright, thick end up, orthographic.
items.look: massive ogre club made from a short tree trunk, thick knobbly end studded with iron spikes and bound with an iron band, thinner rough handle

items.name: Chieftain's buckler
items.view: Flat front view of the round shield face, orthographic.
items.look: small round iron-rimmed wooden buckler painted dark red with a black slashed circle emblem and a central iron boss

items.name: Brown bear
items.look: a real big brown grizzly bear (a natural animal, no fantasy parts), powerful and wild with an alert, fierce look: thick shaggy brown fur, lighter golden-brown tips on the shoulder hump, a darker muzzle, small round ears, mouth closed, big curved claws on heavy paws, short tail

items.name: Mountain lion
items.look: a real big mountain lion cougar (a natural animal, no fantasy parts), lean and powerful with a fierce alert look: tawny golden-brown short fur, pale cream belly, chin and muzzle, dark marks at the sides of the muzzle and the backs of the ears, mouth closed, long thick tail with a dark tip

items.name: Riding horse
items.look: a real sturdy riding horse (a natural animal) in warm colourful high-fantasy game style, calm and noble: glossy chestnut-brown coat, a long flowing cream-blond mane and tail, white socks on the lower legs, a white blaze down the face, dark hooves; a brown leather saddle with a raised front and back on a red-and-gold patterned saddle blanket, stirrups hanging at the sides, a simple leather bridle with reins resting on the neck; mouth closed

items.name: Oak wand
items.view: Flat side view of the whole wand standing upright, tip up, orthographic, filling the height of the picture.
items.look: a slim wizard wand of pale carved oak with a spiral groove, a small glowing blue crystal set in the tip and a leather-wrapped handle with a brass end cap

items.name: Gilded sceptre

items.look: a priestly sceptre: a short straight gold-banded white rod with a leather grip at the bottom and at the top a chunky round gold head with a sun-disc shape and a red gem in its middle

items.name: Seer's orb

items.look: a hand-held focus: a big round glowing violet crystal ball held in a small bronze claw cradle of four curved prongs, with a short thick bronze handle under the cradle

items.name: Bound tome
items.view: Front three-quarter view of the CLOSED book standing upright on its bottom edge, cover facing the viewer, orthographic.
items.look: a thick closed spell book: dark red leather cover with brass corner guards, a brass clasp on the front edge and a simple painted golden rune circle on the cover, cream page edges visible

items.name: Iron warhammer
items.view: Flat side view of the whole weapon standing upright, head up, orthographic, filling the height of the picture.
items.look: a one-handed war hammer: a heavy square iron hammer head with a flat face on one side and a short curved spike on the other, a dark wooden haft with iron bands and a brown leather grip near the bottom

items.name: Watchman halberd
items.view: Flat side view of the whole weapon standing upright, head up, orthographic, filling the height of the picture.
items.look: a long halberd polearm: a broad iron axe blade with a hooked back spike and a straight spear point on top, a long straight dark wooden shaft with iron rings and a red cloth tassel under the head

items.name: Ash quarterstaff
items.view: Flat side view of the whole staff standing upright, orthographic, filling the height of the picture.
items.look: a plain straight fighting quarterstaff of pale ash wood, both ends capped with dark iron bands, two leather-wrapped grips a third of the way from each end

items.name: Hunter shortbow

items.look: a simple short hunting bow of yellow-brown yew wood with a gentle curve, a leather-wrapped grip in the middle and a thin taut string
